modify.body: Update the credentials or settings for "{name}" — saving overwrites the existing connection.
modify.savedValuesDescription: Edit the values stored for this connection.

disconnect.title: Disconnect {name}?
disconnect.message: The saved {engine} connection and its stored credentials are deleted. You can connect it again later.

oauth.reconnectNeeded: {engine} connection needs to be reconnected — refresh token expired.

askUser.selectOnly: This question needs one of the options above. Pick one, or press Skip if you want to type something else.
askUser.rejected: That answer was rejected. Try one of the offered options.
askUser.sendFailed: Could not send your answer. Please try again.
askUser.notAccepted: That answer was not accepted. Reload the conversation to see the question as it stands now.

attachments.needSavedConversation: Pick a project and use a saved conversation before sending file attachments.
attachments.waitForStart: Wait until this conversation has started before sending file attachments.
attachments.sendFailed: Could not send your attachment. Please try again.
attachments.notSent: {count, plural, one {Your file was not sent — the agent asked a question first. It is still attached.} other {Your # files were not sent — the agent asked a question first. They are still attached.}}

tasks.stopFailed: Couldn’t stop the task — it may still be running. Check your connection and try again.
tasks.ownerOnly: Only the owner can run tasks in this shared project.
tasks.loadEarlierFailed: Couldn't load earlier messages. Try again.

codeMode.stopUnchecked: Code Mode is hidden, but running tasks could not be fully checked.
codeMode.stopFailed: {count, plural, one {Code Mode is hidden, but one task could not be stopped.} other {Code Mode is hidden, but # tasks could not be stopped.}}
codeMode.needFolder: Pick a project with a folder before launching Claude Code.
codeMode.needModel: Pick a model before launching Claude Code.
codeMode.noKey: No MindsHub API key configured — sign in with MindsHub or add a key in Settings before using coding mode.
codeMode.createFailed: Could not create the Claude Code task.

deleteTask.title: Delete this task?
deleteTask.message: The conversation history and any per-task scratchpad cells will be removed. This can't be undone.
deleteTask.failed: Couldn't delete this chat. It is back in your list; try again.

deleteTurn.title: Delete this exchange?
deleteTurn.message: This removes both your question and {agent}'s response from the conversation. Any scratchpad cells, artifacts, or memory writes produced as part of this turn stay on disk. This can't be undone.
deleteTurn.unconfirmedRefresh: The last delete here left this list unconfirmed, so it will be refreshed now. Check it, then delete again if you still need to.
deleteTurn.refreshFailed: This conversation could not be refreshed. Reload it before deleting anything else in it.
deleteTurn.messageChanged: This message changed before it could be deleted. Try again.
deleteTurn.unconfirmedNoRefresh: Could not confirm this delete, and the conversation could not be refreshed. Reload this conversation before deleting anything else in it.
deleteTurn.deletedNoRefresh: This exchange was deleted, but the conversation could not be refreshed, so the list may be out of date. Reload this conversation before deleting anything else in it.
deleteTurn.unconfirmed: Could not confirm this delete. It may still have gone through, so this conversation will be refreshed before the next delete in it.
deleteTurn.notDeletedAsShown: The server did not delete this exchange as shown, so the conversation has been refreshed. Check it, then delete again if you still need to.

deleteProject.title: Delete project "{name}"?
deleteProject.messageExternal: The project and its conversations will be removed. Your folder {path} stays where it is and your own files in it are not touched, though Cowork's skills/ and .anton/ folders are left behind inside it. This can't be undone.
deleteProject.message: All conversations, scratchpad output, memory, and artifacts under this project will be removed from disk. This can't be undone.
deleteProject.failed: Couldn't delete this project. Nothing was removed; try again.

compare.unavailableDescription: There are no models to choose from on this deployment, so there's nothing to compare. Your operator decides which models you can pick.

drive.connectMessage: You need to connect your Google Drive account to add files from Drive.
drive.chooseAccountSubtitle: More than one Google Drive account is connected — pick which one to use.

router.unavailableDescription: We couldn’t reach the server. Your link is still valid — try again once you’re back online.

shell.setupErrorBody: Your provider is saved, but we couldn't apply your model. Check your connection, then try again.
shell.serviceUnconfiguredTitle: The service is not configured yet
shell.serviceUnconfiguredBody: Ask your administrator to check the model settings, then try again.
shell.serviceUnavailableBody: The server may be restarting. Wait a moment, then try again.

ownership.title: Whose data is this?
ownership.intro: There is existing data on this computer from before accounts were kept separate, and we can't tell whether it belongs to {who}.
ownership.credentials: It is more than past chats. Taking it also takes the provider API keys saved here and the credentials for any datasources that were connected.
ownership.nothingDeleted: Nothing is deleted either way. If you start fresh, the existing data stays on this computer for whoever it belongs to.
ownership.accountChanged: The signed-in account changed. Sign in again to answer this.
ownership.claimFailed: Could not take that data. Nothing was changed — try again.

updateBanner.readyAutoHint: The new version{hasVersion, select, yes { ({version})} other {}} is downloaded. Restart now to use it, or it installs on its own the next time you quit the app.
updateBanner.newVersion: New version available{hasVersion, select, yes { ({version})} other {}}
updateBanner.abortedHint: The last restart attempt failed. The update is still downloaded. Try again to restart.
updateBanner.abortedHintReason: Last restart attempt failed: {reason}. The update is still downloaded. Try again to restart.
updateBanner.debInstallStep: run {command} from the directory you downloaded it to
updateBanner.otaHint: Reloads the app to finish updating{hasVersion, select, yes { to {version}} other {}}. It also applies on its own the next time you open the app.

tooOld.title: This app is too old for this version of Cowork
tooOld.body: App shell {installed} is installed; {current} is current. Some features are hidden until the app updates.

osCapped.belowFloorTitle: Update macOS to keep using Cowork safely
osCapped.belowFloorBody: This version of the app is unsafe if more than one person signs in to Cowork on this Mac user account: it can show one account's data to the next person who signs in. Newer versions fix this but need {minimum}.
osCapped.title: Your version of macOS no longer receives app updates
osCapped.body: This Mac runs macOS {major}. Update to {minimum} to keep getting app updates. Some features may stop working over time.

timeout.headline: The backend was still starting when the app stopped waiting.
timeout.firstLaunch: This is usually the first launch after an install: the whole Python environment is being scanned as it runs for the first time, which is much slower than every launch after it.
timeout.reopen: Quit the app completely and reopen it. The backend gets a fresh start and normally comes up on the second try.

exited.headline: The backend started and then exited before it finished booting.

spawnError.headline: The backend program couldn't be launched at all.
spawnError.antivirus: Antivirus or endpoint protection blocking the executable is the usual cause; allow the {product} backend and try again.
spawnError.reinstall: If that is not it, re-run the installer to reinstall the backend.

notInstalled.headline: The backend isn't installed yet.
notInstalled.rerun: Re-run the installer to set it up.

credentialClear.headline: The backend couldn't remove the API keys from your last sign-out, so it stopped instead of using them.
credentialClear.reopen: Quit {product} completely and reopen it. The backend tries again on every start.
credentialClear.filesHeld: If it keeps failing, another program may be holding files in the Cowork data folder open; close it, or restart the machine.

incompatible.headline: The backend needs to be updated for this version of {product}.
incompatible.reopen: Quit {product} completely and reopen it so the matching backend can be installed and started.
incompatible.rerun: If the update does not complete, re-run the latest installer.

serverStatus.portHeld: Process {pid} is holding port {port}. Close it (or restart the machine) and start the backend again.
serverStatus.copyLog: If it keeps failing, copy the log below and send it to support.

noLog.timeout: The backend had not printed anything yet when the app stopped waiting, so there is no log to send.
noLog.exited: Nothing was captured in the log because the backend died before it printed anything, so there is no log to send.
noLog.spawnError: The program never ran, so the launch error above is the only evidence there is; there is no log to send.
noLog.notInstalled: Nothing has run yet, so there is no log to send.
noLog.incompatible: The backend responded normally, but it is an older incompatible version; there may be no error log.
noLog.credentialClear: The backend stopped before it printed its reason, so there is no log to send.
noLog.default: No log has been captured yet, so there is nothing to send.

restartConfirm.unknownBody: Cowork cannot tell whether any tasks are running. Restarting stops every running task.
restartConfirm.title: Stop {count, plural, one {# running task} other {# running tasks}} and restart?
restartConfirm.body: Restarting stops the tasks mid-answer. You can restart later from Settings or the update banner.

bootStatus.installing: Installing the update — Cowork will reopen…

addon.moveFailed: Could not move that message to the queue. Please try again.
addon.stayQueued: {agent} could not take it now. It stays in the queue.

voiceCall.callBackPending: {agent} will call you back when it's done
